title: Bounded repeated sampling
statement: For natural numbers $N,L$, a natural-number attempt budget $k$, and a Boolean list $r$, define a partial result as follows. With no attempts, return no result; otherwise, inspect the first $L$ bits of the current list, interpret them as a natural number with the first bit least significant, and return that number if it is less than $N$. If it is not, discard those $L$ bits and repeat with one fewer attempt; if no attempt succeeds, return no result.
hypotheses_covered: attempt budget k is a natural number
input r is a Boolean list
